findings.message: Deviations 1-3 are acceptable but the SPEC does not state them: with --to, format and downgrade checks (step 3) run before the registry lookup (step 2); a non-outage npm failure rolls back and returns CDX-E003; regen/verify child exit codes pass through. Add one line each to 4.19.8.
restoreFiles result is discarded, so a failed restore still reports 'pin, config and lockfile are as they were' (EC-20 byte-exact guarantee). Surface the restore error.
No test for the CDX-E702 allowlist path, the non-outage CDX-E003 rollback, or child regen/verify exit-code pass-through; those behaviours are unasserted.
